title: One line of the tollman's train state (train.jsonl)
description: A change of a wagon train (hal2 plan 0294 step 6; scripts/train_state.py): `slot` is the carrier's field, on an `unhitched` line the field whose ready mark went, on a `barn` line the field already in the barn (`yard`: the yard's car, step 8).

number.description: A formed line: the train's number (hal2 plan 0398 D4, train_state.next_number), which names its land branch `land/train-<number>-<start>`; none on a train formed before it.

cars.description: A formed line: the cars in the order they are merged, each an object with field, branch, head and plan; a joined line: the one car that joined the open train before its push (open_train.py, plan 0490 step 20), likewise; a landed line: their fields.

base.description: The carrier's head before the cars were merged; a joined line: before the car joined; an order line: the carrier's head the fix branches from; a resolving line: the carrier's head the resolve branches from (the cars before the conflicting one merged).

worktree.description: A formed line: the path of the train's own worktree `tollman-train-<plan>-...`, the carrier (hal2 plan 0375 D5).

land_ref.description: A started line: the train's own branch, landed on `land/<land_ref>`: `train-<number>-<start>` picked by merge-to-main from the mark's `--train/--attempt` (plan 0398), or, on a train without a number, the plan-named branch given as `--land-ref` (train_branch.py, plan 0383 D2).

status.description: A red line: the landing's result (`gate_failed`, `conflict`, `error`, ...).

run.description: The land run's address; a run line: the run of the landing that runs now, found by watch.py (plan 0360 step 5); a pause line: the run watched when the pause came (the one it cancels, step 18).

commit.description: A landed line: the commit on the default branch; a yard line: the yard's commit in the carrier's field; a regenerated line: the train's last commit, which wrote the generated files again; a joined line: the carrier's head after the car joined; a started line after a retry: the empty commit that gives the landing a new candidate, so a fresh run (plan 0313 step 13).

files.description: A yard line: the yard's files that ride as the train's first car, each an object with path and hash (the hash of what was carried; none for a deletion). An unhitched line of the slot `yard`: the files that stay out until they change. A regenerated line: the paths of the generated files written again (plan 0313 step 8). A resolving line: the paths that conflict (plan 0522 D18).

yard.description: A landed line of a train the yard rode: what was done in the yard afterwards: dropped (paths), kept (path and why), pulled, why.

pushed.description: A cleared or formed line: what became of the carrier's remote branch, which a dead train's landing had pushed (put back on the base with a leased push, or why not; plan 0313 steps 1 and 14); none when there was nothing to push.

seconds.description: A pretest line: how long the pretest took; a joined line: the pretest of the car's jobs.

local_phase_seconds.description: The first run line of a train: its local phase, from the formed line to the land run's creation (hal2 plan 0467 D21, D23; watch.py). Later run lines (a retry, a resume) carry none.

result.description: A pretest line: its result (pretest.py; incomplete: the budget cut a job or the gate did not answer, not green: the push waits, plan 0522 D7); a joined line: that of the pretest of the car's jobs.

tree.description: A pretest line: the tree of the carrier's HEAD it tested (or the session skipped); a train on another tree is pretested again (plan 0522, pretest_train.due).

jobs.description: A pretest or joined line: one object per configured job, with job, key, state (cached, run, skipped, not needed), seconds, result and why. An order line: the gate jobs (names) its fix must turn green, proven before the fix is taken (fix_proof.py, plan 0522 D5).

local.description: A pretest line: what the pretest, the train's local phase, cost the machine (local_load.py, plan 0472 step 4): seconds, load_peak (the highest 1-minute load average at its marks), disk_ops_s (mean whole-disk operations per second, none where the OS gives none without root) and marks, one object per start, mid (if the pretest lasted a probe interval) and end with t, at, load1 and ops_s (the rate since the mark before).

field.description: A declined line: the field whose join was undone (open_train.decline). An order or fixed line: the car's field the fix order is for, `main` (the barn's red, the tollman's own hand; plan 0360 step 6) or a smuggling field (step 18). A pause line: the smuggle's field that paused the landing; a resumed line: the smuggles since the last resume (plan 0360 step 18). A resolving or resolved line: the conflicting car's field (plan 0522 D18). A woke line: the car's field whose foreman was started for an order (plan 0522 D21).

seq.description: A pause line: the smuggle's ticket number (the queue's `paused_by.seq`): one line per pause.

since.description: A pause line: since when the smuggle paused the landing (the queue's `paused_by.since`).

branch.description: An order line: the side branch the fix is made on, `<NN>-train-fix` or `tollman-train-fix`; a resolving line: the side branch the car's foreman resolves on, `<NN>-train-resolve` (plan 0522 D18).

id.description: An order or fixed line: the fix order's id, `<field>-fix-<n>`; a resolving or resolved line: the resolve order's, `<field>-resolve-<n>`; a woke line: the order the started foreman is for (plan 0522 D21).

sha.description: A fixed line: the fix's commit the foreman answered with; a resolved line: the resolve's (the carrier fast-forwarded to it).

also.description: An order line: another red job for the open early order of this id (plan 0522 D16): its `jobs` and `why` are added to that order, no new order opens; the line has no `branch` and `base`.

unproven.description: A fixed line: the session's why for taking the fix without its proof (`fixed --unproven`, plan 0522 D5).

head.description: A declined line: the field's head that never joins that train again. A barn line: the head of the field that was in the barn already when the tollman woke from smuggle mode (plan 0360 step 25, D75). A resolving line: the conflicting car's head.

ahead.description: A resolving line: the cars merged before the conflicting one that it conflicts with; empty: it conflicts with the barn (plan 0522 D18).

taken.description: A resolving line: the generated files whose conflicts took a side so far, written again once every car is in (generated.py).

unpublished.description: A resolving line: why the base is not on the carrier's remote branch yet; the round pushes it again before the order goes (`tollman.py resolve-publish`).

how.description: A barn line: a waiting hitch (its mark cleared), a car of a formed train (it left the train, D76) or of a running train (only recorded).

by.description: An unhitched line of a car of the standing train: taken out by the user's own command (`--by-user`, plan 0360 D3); the session never takes a car out of a formed train.
